intro.title: Grimoire of Golden Threads
intro.description: Every grace that leads to my stead, bound into this grimoire: fellow Tarnished, workshops of trial, the Roundtable arenas, and messengers of direct summoning.
section.network.title: Fellow Tarnished
section.network.description: The Sites of Grace where words may pass — to converse, to band, to follow the faint glow of my daily craft.
section.craft.title: Roundtable Practice
section.craft.description: Where weapons are forged and ashes tested: code katas, front-end trials and the arts of blade and cipher.
section.arena.title: Quiet Hunting Fields
section.arena.description: A few wanderings of jest, to keep the eye keen upon the Lands Between of leisure.
section.summon.title: Direct Invocation
section.summon.description: The furled fingers and golden signs by which one may call upon me directly.
outro: May grace guide the path you choose, O Tarnished. Until the Erdtree stirs anew.
